description: Use when a trip to Vietnam starts within about a week, or the user is already there, and you need to know whether the national forecasting centre has issued storm, tropical depression, heavy rain, flood, flash flood, landslide or rough-sea bulletins. Returns the latest bulletin titles (verbatim, Vietnamese) with links, optionally filtered to those naming a province or place, plus how fresh the list is. It quotes official bulletins and does not forecast; if the list is stale it says the status is unknown.

province.description: Province or place, accents optional, e.g. "Quang Ninh", "Hue", "Ha Giang"

name: weather_hazard_alerts

error.description: Present only when the input was invalid

title: Vietnam official storm and flood bulletins
